acceptedAnswer.text: Honestly: it varies enough that a number would be a guess. Technical fixes can register quickly; content and authority take longer. We would rather tell you what changed than invent a date.
No, and neither can anyone else. Search engines rank on signals no agency controls. What we can do is make sure nothing about your site is holding it back.

mainEntity.name: Do I need new content every month?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not automatically. A content retainer that produces pages nobody searches for is a subscription, not a strategy. We would rather fix structure first and write only where there is real intent.

mainEntity.name: What if my site is on a platform you did not build?

acceptedAnswer.text: That is normal. We audit what is there and either fix it in place or tell you honestly when the platform itself is the constraint.
